resourceName: Guangxi Luchuan IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Guangxi Luchuan IFM (conversion of logged to protected  forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Luchuan County, Yulin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of China by Luchuan County Urban Construction Investment Co., Ltd., the geo-coordinate of the  project proponent is 110°04'E -110°25'E and 21°53'N - 22°19'N, the total area is 1154 km2, which includes the Improved Forest Management (IFM) of the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.
The area of the project activity is 19640.11 ha, including 5988 subcompartments spreading over Daqiao Town, Gucheng Town, Liangtian Town, Mapo Town, Michang Town, Pingle Town, Qinghu Town, Shapo Town, Shanluo Town,Wenquan Town,Wushi Town,Hengshan Township,Shahu Township,Tanmian Township, Luchuan County Forest Farm of Guangxi Luchuan. All these forests are state-owned forests or privately-owned or collective-owned, and have the legal right to forest ownership. The species involved in the project are Broadleaf Mix and Pinus massoniana.
Before the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged based on a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 4,478,267 tCO2e in 20 years, the average annual emission reduction is 223,913 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 4,120,005 tCO2e in 20 years, and average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 206,000 tCO2e.
The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation, rocky desertification prevention and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
